findings.title: 3 measured text colour pair(s) meet 1.4.3 AA
findings.reason: Computed from rendered styles for the sampled text in the region. Unresolved samples are reported separately.

findings.title: Median 40 characters per line on a 390px viewport
findings.reason: Phones should keep a useful text size and use the available width rather than force a desktop line length (10th–90th percentile 34–45, 176 lines).

findings.title: Line height 1.75 is outside 1.4–1.7
findings.reason: Ratio of measured baseline distance to font size. This is a starting range, not a requirement. No reliable quantitative improvement established.
findings.suggestion: Very open spacing increases vertical travel; consider 1.5–1.7 unless readers chose it.

findings.title: First declared font appears unavailable; likely rendering sans-serif
findings.reason: Declared: Gabarito, sans-serif. Detection compares rendered widths and is an estimate. Fallback fonts change apparent size and wrapping.
findings.suggestion: Load the intended font or choose a stack whose fallbacks have similar proportions.

findings.title: No content loss detected under WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing
findings.reason: Checked hidden text, spilled text and horizontal scrolling after applying line-height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2em, letter spacing 0.12em and word spacing 0.16em (document and open shadow roots). Loss of functionality other than hidden text (e.g. broken interactions) is not detected automatically.

findings.title: No content loss detected under 320 CSS px reflow
findings.reason: Checked hidden text, spilled text and horizontal scrolling after rendering at a 320×256 CSS px viewport. Loss of functionality other than hidden text (e.g. broken interactions) is not detected automatically.

findings.title: Content forces horizontal page scrolling
findings.reason: This element extends 5px beyond the viewport, so reading requires scrolling in two directions. (Approximation scenario.)
findings.suggestion: Remove fixed widths/min-widths and white-space: nowrap; use max-width: 100% and overflow-wrap: anywhere for long strings.
